analysis: Derive request/artifact/delivery/end-to-end transitions and yields on 12 primary request clusters per system. Report all planned slots and exact counts. Paired end-to-end differences use identical requests; family-cluster bootstrap is enumerated on the two held-out families (four ordered resamples), explicitly illustrative. No mutation-level confidence intervals, population guarantees, aesthetic rankings, optimization claims or speed-superiority claims. Costs are cold-process wall times and max per-process RSS, not summed pipeline RSS.

budget.music21_limit: Parent wall limit; no native search clock. DAG realization and first viable path, never all-progressions enumeration.

equivalences: Positive PPQN scaling with exact rational note times; ignored velocity/program/track-name fields. Track and channel voice identity, key/meter/tempo remain exact. Repeated attacks are not coalesced into sustained notes.
fault_eligibility: Apply all twelve predeclared slots only to untouched outputs passing both semantic implementations and full external-request/delivery checks. Nonconforming, unsupported, crashed or timed-out baselines retain INAPPLICABLE slots with reasons. Verify mutation non-noop before evaluating. Repaired digests and coordinated event/MIDI mutations prevent integrity-only shortcuts.
freeze: Commit and hash protocol, source, corpus, budgets and fault plan before held-out collection; keep local original history in a Git bundle. No externally timestamped preregistration is claimed. Any held-out-informed change requires a new version and fresh holdout.
order: Sequential fresh processes; rotate the three-system order by request index; one thread and no overlapping generation.

profiles.constraint-music: Pinned benchmark conditioning subclass adds degrees, root positions, constant voices and V-I obligations to the existing compiled CP-SAT model; native quarter-note SATB export; native ranges/leap/repetition rules remain disclosed in captured input.
profiles.diatony: Pinned upstream model is unchanged; benchmark subclass posts complete triads and all-voice V-I leading-tone obligations before first-feasible Gecode DFS. Original MIDI retained alongside separately declared renderer; whole notes.
profiles.music21: Native figured-bass model with prescribed root bass register 48+root_pc, whole notes, original default rules plus benchmark Segment subclass posting the all-voice V-I leading-tone obligation before generation; native chorale MIDI with explicit request tempo. Pinned movement-DAG first-path selector.

rights: Owner-authorized execution here. Proprietary license stays unchanged; independent outside replay uses case-by-case written research-run permission, with a provided request/grant template. No automatic public grant or completed outside replication is claimed.
shared_contract: Major diatonic complete root-position triads on prescribed four-quarter harmonic blocks, constant voicing inside blocks, quarter/whole notes, four explicit noncrossing voices, no parallel perfects between harmonic blocks, ascending semitone resolution of a leading tone on V-I, exact voiced SMF events and key/meter/tempo. No rests, ties, fixed given voice, or contextual chromatic harmony is supported.
split: Entire held-out harmonic families and six tonic keys are absent from development. Same request identities go to all three systems. Samples are purposive, not population-random.
